content: Rhys,  Congratulations, we have finished our review and I would like to extend an offer to you for Revenant, as I have said you will have the first choice to do the others in the series as they release based on the schedule, I shared with you before. Here is what I would like to offer for the first book.  115 PFH and 10% royalty managed through ACX.  Let me know if this is acceptable to complete Revenant.    I also wanted to share with you my expectations on the book. As I know every author is different to work with.  Based on your performance I have no need to review your work ahead of time, strictly  out of curiosity I would love to hear chapters as they get finished, but it is not necessary.  I will be personally available at any time to answer questions or review scenes  Prior to release I would like to review the book as a final sign off.  Let me know if you have any requirements as well.  I am really excited to hear my book come to life through your performance Ray
